# Qwen3-Coder template fixture

The chat template in qwen3-coder-template.json is taken without modification from Qwen/Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct tokenizer_config.json, published by the Qwen team under Apache License 2.0. Source URL, retrieval time and SHA-256 are recorded in the fixture. Only the template is included; no model weights or full tokenizer are redistributed. The accompanying QWEN-APACHE-2.0.txt contains the applicable license. AMU test harness code is separate.
